test_selection: Nine RISC-V Architectural Tests maintained by the recorded test repository exercise compressed arithmetic instructions in both 16-bit positions of a 32-bit fetch block. They retain the CPU developers' complete-CPU execution and Spike comparison while targeting the selected RVC realignment behavior.

reconstruction.test_sources: checkout the recorded RISC-V Architectural Tests revision and select the nine recorded C-extension sources with harness/testlist_instr_realign.yaml

port_alignment_observation: Check serving_unaligned_o when output slot zero is valid. The flag is high when slot zero completes an instruction split across fetch blocks, and low for a complete instruction from the current block.
